data.title: IDEAYA Biosciences (IDYA) Doses First Patient In Phase 3 Uveal Melanoma Trial
data.description:

  • OptimUM-11 is evaluating darovasertib plus crizotinib as adjuvant therapy for primary uveal melanoma patients at high risk of metastasis.
  • The study is described as the first global registrational trial of this drug combination in the adjuvant setting for primary uveal melanoma.

How does OptimUM-11 change the market opportunity for IDEAYA Biosciences?

OptimUM-11 targets an area with no approved adjuvant therapies for primary uveal melanoma, where 10,000 to 12,000 new cases are diagnosed globally each year and up to 50% later develop metastatic disease. If darovasertib plus crizotinib eventually secures approval, the combination could address both a rare cancer and a clear treatment gap.

The study is described as a first global registrational adjuvant trial for primary uveal melanoma using this drug pair. This gives IDEAYA an early opportunity to help shape the treatment standard around PKC and cMET inhibition. Parallel work in metastatic disease and neoadjuvant settings suggests the business is aiming to build a franchise that spans the full disease course.

For this program, the key number is the approximately 450 patient target for OptimUM-11, since full enrollment will be a practical marker of momentum and trial maturity. Bulls argue 1-800-FLOWERS.COM is rebuilding its engine, with centralization, data driven marketing, and loyalty turning a pressured gifting brand into a higher margin, more repeat focused platform. Bears worry this is a shrinking, highly seasonal business with rising competitive and marketing pressure and limited room for error given leverage. This quarter leans their way. Management also guided fiscal 2027 revenue to decline mid single digits and flagged the need for potential asset sales or capital raising, with net debt at US$128 million and cash at US$11 million.
